title: CFTC nominee questions public benefit of prediction markets as legal fight grows
summary: One of the two picks to join the regulatory commission, Democratic nominee Matthew Rowland, said he hopes to have a say in prediction markets rulemaking.
content: During a regulatory commission nomination process, Democratic nominee Matthew Rowland raised questions regarding the public benefit of prediction markets amid ongoing legal challenges. Rowland expressed a desire to have a direct role in shaping future rulemaking related to these prediction platforms as legal debates continue to grow across the industry.
content_ta: ஒழுங்குமுறை ஆணையத்துக்கான நியமனத்தின் போது, Democratic nominee-ரான Matthew Rowland, prediction markets-ன் பொது நலன் குறித்து கேள்வி எழுப்பியுள்ளார். இந்தத் துறை தொடர்பான சட்டப் போராட்டம் அதிகரித்து வரும் நிலையில், prediction markets விதிகளுக்கு வடிவம் கொடுப்பதில் தனக்கு முக்கிய பங்கு இருக்கும் என்று அவர் நம்பிக்கை தெரிவித்தார்.

title: Nvidia board rejects Huang comeback despite record $116B quarter
summary: Nvidia beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations by 5.6% and issued a stronger-than-expected sales forecast, while its board resisted growing calls for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement.
content: Nvidia reported a record $116B quarter, beating Wall Street revenue expectations by 5.6% and issuing a strong sales forecast. Despite the massive financial success, the Nvidia board rejected growing calls for Jensen Huang to make a comeback.
content_ta: Nvidia நிறுவனமானது சாதனை அளவிலான $116B வருவாய் ஈட்டியுள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. Wall Street எதிர்பார்ப்புகளை 5.6% தாண்டி புதிய சாதனை படைத்துள்ள போதிலும், Jensen Huang மீண்டும் தலைமை பதவிக்கு வருவதற்கான கோரிக்கைகளை Nvidia வாரியம் நிராகரித்துள்ளது.

title: Researchers train AI in simulation and unlock real robot skills
summary:
PEAR researchers report transfer of pickup and block-alignment skills to different hardware, with long reasoning delays limiting use.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: Researchers have successfully trained artificial intelligence models within simulations and transferred those skills to real-world robotic hardware. According to reports from PEAR, the robots acquired pickup and block-alignment capabilities. However, researchers noted that significant reasoning delays currently limit the practical deployment of these newly acquired robotic skills in live environments.
content_ta: சிமுலேஷன் மூலம் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு தொழில்நுட்பத்தை பயிற்சி செய்து, அதனை நிஜ உலக ரோபோக்களுக்கு வெற்றிகரமாக மாற்றியுள்ளனர் ஆய்வாளர்கள். PEAR வெளியிட்டுள்ள தகவலின்படி, இந்த ரோபோக்கள் பொருட்களை எடுப்பது மற்றும் தொகுதிகளை சீரமைப்பது போன்ற திறன்களைப் பெற்றுள்ளன. எனினும், நீண்ட காரணத்தடை (reasoning delays) காரணமாக இவற்றின் பயன்பாடு தற்போது வரம்புக்குட்பட்டதாக உள்ளதாக ஆய்வாளர்கள் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளனர்.

title: Bitcoin faces a liquidity drain as Anthropic IPO unlocks millions
summary:
Anthropic’s staged releases create selling risk, while issuance, cash demand and the path to weaker Bitcoin liquidity remain distinct questions.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: Bitcoin is facing potential liquidity pressure following the Anthropic IPO, which has unlocked millions of shares. Analysts note that these staged releases create selling risks for the market. Meanwhile, broader questions remain regarding token issuance, cash demand, and future liquidity trends impacting the cryptocurrency ecosystem.
content_ta: Anthropic IPO-க்கு பிறகு மில்லியன் கணக்கான பங்குகள் வெளியிடப்பட்டுள்ளதால் Bitcoin சந்தை பணப்புழக்க அழுத்தத்தை எதிர்கொள்கிறது. இந்த கட்டங்களாக வெளியிடப்படும் பங்குகள் சந்தையில் விற்பனை அழுத்தத்தை ஏற்படுத்துவதாக ஆய்வாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர். இதற்கிடையில், கிரிப்டோகரன்சி சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பைப் பாதிக்கும் டோக்கன் வெளியீடு மற்றும் எதிர்கால பணப்புழக்கப் போக்குகள் குறித்து கேள்விகள் எழுகின்றன.

title: From Delray Beach to the Exumas: William DeBilzan Has Started the Official $ONELOVE Painting
summary: The Florida artist has begun a commissioned original for Captain Robbie Olson’s One Love Sailing Coin, with an unveiling planned aboard the 82-foot catamaran One Love². On a short trip to Delray Beach, Florida, Captain Robbie Olson walked into the gallery of his longtime friend, artist William DeBilzan, and left with something he says he […]
content: Florida artist William DeBilzan has started a commissioned original painting for Captain Robbie Olson's One Love Sailing Coin. The official $ONELOVE artwork will be unveiled aboard the 82-foot catamaran One Love². The collaboration follows a visit by Captain Olson to DeBilzan's art gallery in Delray Beach, Florida.
content_ta: ஃப்ளோரிடாவைச் சேர்ந்த கலைஞர் William DeBilzan, Captain Robbie Olson-ன் One Love Sailing Coin நிறுவனத்துக்காக புதிய ஒரிஜினல் ஓவியத்தை வரையத் தொடங்கியுள்ளார். இந்த அதிகாரப்பூர்வ $ONELOVE ஓவியம் 82 அடி நீளமுள்ள One Love² கதமரன் கப்பலில் வெளியிடப்படவுள்ளது. ஃப்ளோரிடாவின் Delray Beach பகுதியில் உள்ள William DeBilzan-ன் கலைக்கூடத்துக்கு Captain Robbie Olson சென்றதை அடுத்து இந்த ஒத்துழைப்பு உருவாகியுள்ளது.

title: Bitcoin could benefit if AI downturn prompts Fed policy reversal, CoinShares’ portfolio manager says
summary:
A potential Fed policy shift due to an AI downturn could create a favorable environment for Bitcoin, highlighting its role as a hedge.
The post Bitcoin could benefit if AI downturn prompts Fed policy reversal, CoinShares’ portfolio manager says appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A potential shift in Federal Reserve monetary policy, potentially triggered by an economic downturn in the artificial intelligence sector, could create a favorable environment for Bitcoin. According to CoinShares' portfolio manager, such a change in macroeconomic policy might enhance Bitcoin's appeal as a hedge against broader financial market instability, drawing increased attention from investors navigating shifting economic conditions.
content_ta: செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவுத் துறையில் ஏற்படும் மந்தநிலை காரணமாக Federal Reserve-இன் கொள்கையில் மாற்றம் ஏற்பட்டால், அது Bitcoin-க்கு சாதகமான சூழலை உருவாக்கக்கூடும் என்று CoinShares நிறுவனத்தின் போர்ட்ஃபோலியோ மேலாளர் தெரிவித்துள்ளார். இத்தகைய மேக்ரோ பொருளாதார மாற்றங்கள் Bitcoin-ஐ ஒரு பாதுகாப்பான முதலீட்டாக மாற்றக்கூடும் என்றும் அவர் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளார்.

title: The Fintech Times: Singapore Fintech Festival 2026 Special Edition
summary:
Download The Fintech Times Singapore Fintech Festival 2026 Special Edition, with cover star Murtaza Ali, CEO of JazzCash, plus the Gulf to Asia corridor, Brett King's Bank 5.0 and who pays for scams.
The post The Fintech Times: Singapore Fintech Festival 2026 Special Edition appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: The Fintech Times has released its Singapore Fintech Festival 2026 Special Edition. The digital publication features Murtaza Ali, CEO of JazzCash, as its cover star. It includes insightful discussions on the Gulf to Asia corridor, Brett King's Bank 5.0 vision, and critical debates regarding liability and compensation for digital financial scams.
content_ta: The Fintech Times தனது Singapore Fintech Festival 2026 Special Edition வெளியீட்டை வெளியிட்டுள்ளது. இந்த டிஜிட்டல் பதிப்பில் JazzCash இன் CEOஆன Murtaza Ali அட்டைப் பட நாயகனாக இடம்பெற்றுள்ளார். இது Gulf to Asia corridor, Brett King இன் Bank 5.0 மற்றும் டிஜிட்டல் நிதி மோசடிகளுக்கான பொறுப்பு குறித்த விவாதங்களை உள்ளடக்கியுள்ளது.

title: Ledger hardware implant saga reaches Dubai’s Virgin Megastore
summary: Two Ledger owners reported losing a combined $604,000 in crypto from hardware wallets they said were purchased at authorized retailer Virgin Megastore in Dubai.
content: The controversy surrounding compromised Ledger hardware wallets has reached Dubai after two owners reported losing a combined $604,000 in cryptocurrency. The victims stated they purchased their devices from an authorized Virgin Megastore location in Dubai, raising serious security concerns regarding the retail supply chain and the safety of physical crypto storage devices bought from mainstream authorized stores.
content_ta: compromising செய்யப்பட்ட Ledger ஹார்டுவேர் வாலட்கள் தொடர்பான சர்ச்சை துபாயை எட்டியுள்ளது. அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்ட சில்லறை விற்பனையாளரான Virgin Megastore-ல் வாங்கிய வாலட்கள் மூலம் தங்களின் cryptocurrency-களை இழந்ததாக இரண்டு உரிமையாளர்கள் புகார் அளித்துள்ளனர். இதில் மொத்தம் $604,000 இழப்பு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளதாகத் தெரிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்தச் சம்பவம் சில்லறை விநியோகச் சங்கிலி மற்றும் பாதுகாப்பு குறித்து தீவிர கவலைகளை எழுப்பியுள்ளது.

title: Coinbase AI defense blocks $4.7 million from being sent to deepfake Elon Musk scam
summary: The company said the system prevented about 91% of the attempted transfers linked to the fake Tesla livestream, with no human intervention.
content: Coinbase announced that its AI defense system successfully blocked $4.7 million from being sent to a deepfake Elon Musk scam. According to the company, the automated system prevented about 91% of attempted transfers related to a fake Tesla livestream without requiring any human intervention.
content_ta: Elon Musk-ன் டீப்ஃபேக் மோசடிக்கு அனுப்பப்படவிருந்த 4.7 மில்லியன் டாலர்களை Coinbase-ன் AI பாதுகாப்பு அமைப்பு வெற்றிகரமாகத் தடுத்ததாக அறிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. எந்தவொரு மனித தலவுமின்றி, போலி Tesla லைவ்ஸ்ட்ரீம் தொடர்பான முயற்சிகளில் சுமார் 91 சதவீதப் பணப் பரிமாற்றங்களை இந்த தானியங்கி அமைப்பு தடுத்ததாக நிறுவனம் தெரிவித்துள்ளது.

title: What’s happening to crypto startup valuations?
summary:
The markdowns in crypto unicorns may dampen investor confidence, impacting broader market sentiment and Ethereum's future price trajectory.
The post Crypto unicorns from 2021 boom see 50%-70% markdowns in secondary markets appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Crypto unicorns from the 2021 boom are facing severe markdowns of 50% to 70% in secondary markets. These steep valuation cuts are dampening investor confidence, which may impact broader market sentiment and potentially influence the future price trajectory of Ethereum.
content_ta: 2021 பூம் காலத்து Crypto யூனிகார்ன்கள் இரண்டாம் நிலை சந்தைகளில் 50% முதல் 70% வரை கடுமையான விலை வீழ்ச்சியை சந்தித்து வருகின்றன. இந்த மதிப்பீட்டு குறைப்பு முதலீட்டாளர்களின் நம்பிக்கையை குலைத்து, பரந்த சந்தை உணர்வை பாதிப்பதோடு, Ethereum இன் எதிர்கால விலை போக்கையும் பாதிக்கக்கூடும்.

title: Lighter Reopens Withdrawals After Nonce-Reuse Error Exposes Trader API Keys
summary: Decentralized derivatives venue Lighter says deposits and withdrawals have resumed following a November 16 security incident that initially froze access. The latest.
content: Decentralized derivatives venue Lighter has resumed deposits and withdrawals following a security incident that temporarily froze user access. The platform experienced a nonce-reuse error that exposed trader API keys. Lighter confirmed that operations are now back to normal after addressing the vulnerability.
content_ta: டீசென்ட்ரலைஸ்டு டெரிவேட்டிவ்ஸ் தளமான Lighter, பாதுகாப்புப் பிரச்சனை காரணமாக தற்காலிகமாக நிறுத்தப்பட்டிருந்த டெபாசிட் மற்றும் வித்ட்ராவல் சேவைகளை மீண்டும் தொடங்கியுள்ளது. டிரேடர்களின் API கீகளை வெளிப்படுத்திய 'nonce-reuse' பிழை காரணமாக இந்த பாதுகாப்புச் சம்பவம் ஏற்பட்டது. இந்தச் சிக்கலைத் சரிசெய்த பிறகு செயல்பாடுகள் வழக்க நிலைக்குத் திரும்பியுள்ளதாக Lighter உறுதிப்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: Bitcoin tests $62K support – Can BTC bulls hold without Spot demand?
summary: Despite the price bounce from $62k, selling pressure has not begun to ease noticeably, as the apparent demand metric showed.
content: Bitcoin recently tested the $62,000 support level, sparking questions about whether bulls can maintain this price without significant spot demand. Although the price experienced a bounce from $62,000, market data indicates that selling pressure has not eased noticeably, suggesting ongoing caution among investors as the apparent demand metric continues to be closely monitored.
content_ta: Bitcoin சமீபத்தில் $62,000 ஆதரவு நிலையைச் சோதித்தது, இது ஸ்பாட் தேவை இல்லாமல் பம்புகள் (bulls) இந்த விலையைத் தக்கவைக்க முடியுமா என்ற கேள்விகளை எழுப்பியுள்ளது. $62,000-ல் இருந்து விலை மீண்டெழுந்த போதிலும், விற்பனை அழுத்தம் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க அளவில் குறையவில்லை என்று சந்தை தரவுகள் காட்டுகின்றன, இதனால் முதலீட்டாளர்கள் தொடர்ந்து எச்சரிக்கையுடன் இருக்கின்றனர்.

title: Microsoft Stock Hits Seven-Week Low: Is a Bigger Drop Coming?
summary:
Microsoft stock hit a 2-month low as rate-hike bets, an Anthropic rival, and outages hit MSFT. See the key support levels.
The post Microsoft Stock Hits Seven-Week Low: Is a Bigger Drop Coming? appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Microsoft stock recently touched a seven-week low, driven by rate-hike expectations, competition from an Anthropic rival, and recent service outages. Market analysts are closely watching the key support levels to determine if the technology giant's shares will experience a larger decline in the near future.
content_ta: Microsoft பங்குகளின் விலை சமீபத்தில் ஏழு வாரங்களில் இல்லாத அளவுக்குக் குறைந்துள்ளது. வட்டி விகித உயர்வு குறித்த எதிர்பார்ப்புகள், Anthropic நிறுவனத்தின் போட்டியாளர் மற்றும் சேவைத் தடையால் இந்த வீழ்ச்சி ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. MSFT பங்குகளின் அடுத்த கட்ட நகர்வுகளை முதலீட்டாளர்கள் உன்னிப்பாகக் கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: Brad Gerstner says Anthropic could support its 2027 revenue forecast with about 500 MW of compute
summary:
Anthropic's strategic allocation of compute resources to paying clients signals robust revenue growth potential, influencing future market valuations.
The post Brad Gerstner says 26% of Anthropic’s compute budget served paying customers in early 2026 appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Brad Gerstner stated that Anthropic could potentially support its 2027 revenue forecast using approximately 500 megawatts of compute. Recent reports indicate that a significant portion of Anthropic's compute budget was dedicated to serving paying customers in early 2026, highlighting strong growth potential and influencing future market valuations for the company.
content_ta: 2027-ம் ஆண்டுக்கான வருவாய் கணிப்பை ஆதரிக்க Anthropic நிறுவனம் சுமார் 500 மெகாவாட் கம்ப்யூட் திறனைப் பயன்படுத்தலாம் என்று Brad Gerstner தெரிவித்துள்ளார். 2026-ன் தொடக்கத்தில் Anthropic-ன் கம்ப்யூட் பட்ஜெட்டில் கணிசமான பகுதி கட்டணம் செலுத்தும் வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்குச் சேவை செய்யப் பயன்படுத்தப்பட்டதாக சமீபத்திய அறிக்கைகள் காட்டுகின்றன.

title: CoreWeave stock rises as Nvidia emphasizes disciplined financing approach
summary:
Nvidia's disciplined financing boosts market confidence in CoreWeave, reducing bankruptcy concerns and signaling strong neocloud support.
The post CoreWeave stock rises as Nvidia emphasizes disciplined financing approach appeared first on Crypto Briefing.

title: Aave App Launches on TRON, Bringing USDT Deposits to Mobile Users on Android and iOS
summary: Geneva, Switzerland –  TRON DAO, the community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet through blockchain technology and decentralized applications (dApps), today announced that the Aave App, a high-yield savings mobile app developed and managed by Aave Labs, will add support for USDT (TRC-20) deposits on the TRON network as it expands to Android following its initial launch on iOS.   The launch combines Android’s global reach with TRON’s leading role in the stablecoin ecosystem, expanding mobile access to onchain savings opportunities that are not accessible on traditional savings apps. With support for USDT on TRON, eligible users in supported jurisdictions can now deposit USDT on TRON and start earning yield on their savings.   Android’s extensive global footprint offers a significant distribution opportunity for digital asset applications, particularly in markets where stablecoins are used for payments, remittances, and savings. TRON provides an established infrastructure for this opportunity, with more than $94 billion in circulating USDT, the largest circulating supply of Tether’s dollar-pegged stablecoin among blockchain networks. TRON also supports a broad range of stablecoin use cases, including payments, cross-border transfers, and digital asset transactions.   Aave is building the World’s Savings App, a simple, globally accessible tool designed to help people grow and manage their savings, with a delightful design experience on the surface and powerful onchain finance infrastructure working under the hood. Users of the app can earn yield on their savings, enjoy flexible access to their funds, and benefit from the Balance Protection program. They can also deposit and withdraw via stablecoins or banks in eligible countries and project their potential savings growth over the years with a future simulator. Following its availability on iOS, the Android launch expands the app’s mobile reach, while TRON support connects users to one of the largest USDT ecosystems in onchain finance.   “Aave Labs has a proven track record of building leading DeFi products, and the Aave App brings that expertise to everyday users,” said Justin Sun, Founder of TRON. “With TRON support on Android and iOS, more people can use the USDT they already hold on TRON to access simple, accessible onchain savings with the Aave App.”   “Millions of people in emerging economies already rely on stablecoins on TRON to save and send money,” said Stani Kulechov, Founder and CEO of Aave Labs. “The Aave App lets them earn on those dollars.”   By enabling USDT deposits through the Aave App on Android, the integration connects TRON’s established stablecoin ecosystem with a consumer-focused mobile application. The launch reflects the continued convergence of mobile applications and blockchain infrastructure, as consumer-focused products work to make digital assets and decentralized financial services more accessible worldwide.   About TRON DAO TRON DAO is a community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet via blockchain technology and dApps.   Founded in September 2017, the TRON blockchain has experienced significant growth since its MainNet launch in May 2018. Today, TRON hosts the largest circulating supply of USD Tether (USDT) stablecoin, which currently exceeds $94 billion. As of November 2026, the TRON blockchain has recorded over 414 million in total user accounts, more than 16 billion in total transactions, and over $24 billion in total value locked (TVL), based on TRONSCAN. Recognized as the global settlement layer for stablecoin transactions and everyday purchases with proven success, TRON is “Moving Trillions, Empowering Billions.”   TRONNetwork | TRONDAO | X | YouTube | Telegram | Discord | Reddit | GitHub | Medium | Forum About Aave Labs Aave Labs is a core contributor in the Aave network and builds products that make saving, lending and borrowing simple and accessible worldwide. Aave is the world’s largest onchain lending network, with more than $30 billion in net deposits. Users, fintechs and financial institutions use it to earn interest on stablecoins and other assets and to borrow against them, 24/7, with every transaction visible onchain. The network is governed by the Aave DAO, where AAVE holders vote on changes to the network and its treasury.   Aave Labs’ products include Aave App, a savings app for everyone; Aave Pro, for advanced lending and borrowing; Aave Kit, which lets fintechs and businesses offer savings and loans to their users; and Aave Horizon, an institutional platform for borrowing stablecoins against tokenized real-world assets. For more information, visit aave.com.
content: The Aave App has launched on Android, adding support for USDT TRC-20 deposits on the TRON network following its initial iOS release. This integration brings high-yield onchain savings opportunities to mobile users globally, combining TRON's large stablecoin ecosystem with Aave's consumer-focused financial application.
content_ta: Aave ஆப் ஆனது ஆண்ட்ராய்டு தளத்தில் வெளியிடப்பட்டுள்ளது, இது அதன் ஆரம்பகால iOS வெளியீட்டைத் தொடர்ந்து TRON நெட்வொர்க்கில் USDT TRC-20 டெபாசிட்டுகளுக்கான ஆதரவைச் சேர்க்கிறது. இந்த ஒருங்கிணைப்பு மொபைல் பயனர்களுக்கு உலகளவில் ஆன்செயின் சேமிப்பு வாய்ப்புகளைக் கொண்டுவருகிறது, TRON-ன் பெரிய ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பை Aave-ன் நுகர்வோர் மையமாகக் கொண்ட நிதிப் பயன்பாட்டுடன் இணைக்கிறது.

title: Berkshire Hathaway Sells 83.9% of Stake in One US Bank in Six Months While Trimming Bank of America by $1,500,000,000
summary:
Billionaire Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway has sold most of its Capital One (COF) stake in just two quarters. The conglomerate held 1,150,000 Capital One (COF) shares on September 30th, down from 7,150,000 on March 31st, reports Yahoo Finance. Berkshire cut the stake to 3,000,000 COF shares in the second quarter, then to 1,150,000 in the […]
The post Berkshire Hathaway Sells 83.9% of Stake in One US Bank in Six Months While Trimming Bank of America by $1,500,000,000 appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Billionaire Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway significantly reduced its investments in the banking sector over two quarters. The conglomerate sold the vast majority of its Capital One stake, dropping from over seven million shares down to just over one million. Additionally, Berkshire Hathaway trimmed its massive holding in Bank of America by approximately 1.5 billion dollars.
content_ta: Warren Buffett-க்கு சொந்தமான Berkshire Hathaway நிறுவனம் தனது வங்கித்துறை முதலீடுகளை கணிசமாகக் குறைத்துள்ளது. Capital One நிறுவனத்தில் தான் வைத்திருந்த பங்குகளில் பெரும்பகுதியை இந்த நிறுவனம் விற்றுள்ளது. மேலும், Bank of America நிறுவனத்திலுள்ள தனது பங்குகளில் சுமார் 1.5 பில்லியன் டாலர் மதிப்பிலான பங்குகளை Berkshire Hathaway குறைத்துள்ளது.

title: Strategy stock could plunge 76% to $23, chart analyst warns
summary: Aksel Kibar, who has tracked Bitcoin’s price action since at least 2018, made the bearish call, citing a still-active head-and-shoulders pattern on MicroStrategy’s (MSTR) daily chart.
content: Chart analyst Aksel Kibar has issued a bearish warning for MicroStrategy stock, suggesting it could plunge 76% to $23. Kibar, known for tracking Bitcoin price action since at least 2018, based his projection on a still-active head-and-shoulders pattern visible on the daily chart of MSTR.
content_ta: சார்ட் அனலிஸ்ட் Aksel Kibar, MicroStrategy ஸ்டாக் 76 சதவீதம் சரிந்து $23 வரை குறையக்கூடும் என்று எச்சரித்துள்ளார். குறைந்தபட்சம் 2018 முதல் Bitcoin விலை நகர்வுகளைக் கண்காணித்து வரும் Kibar, MSTR நிறுவனத்தின் டெய்லி சார்ட்டில் உள்ள head-and-shoulders பேட்டர்னைச் சுட்டிக்காட்டி இந்த எச்சரிக்கையை விடுத்துள்ளார்.

title: Hyundai tests AI agent commerce on JPMorgan’s Kinexys blockchain
summary:
AI-driven automation on private blockchains could revolutionize financial transactions, enhancing efficiency while maintaining compliance.
The post Hyundai Card tests AI agent commerce on JPMorgan’s Kinexys blockchain appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Hyundai Card has successfully tested AI agent commerce on JPMorgan's Kinexys blockchain platform. This initiative highlights the growing integration of artificial intelligence and private blockchain technology in financial transactions, aiming to improve operational efficiency and maintain regulatory compliance for modern corporate payments.
content_ta: Hyundai Card நிறுவனம் JPMorgan-ன் Kinexys பிளாக்செயின் தளத்தில் AI ஏஜென்ட் காமர்ஸ் பரிசோதனையை வெற்றிகரமாக நடத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த முயற்சி நிதி பரிவர்த்தனைகளில் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு மற்றும் தனியார் பிளாக்செயின் தொழில்நுட்பத்தின் வளர்ந்துவரும் ஒருங்கிணைப்பைக் காட்டுகிறது, இது நிறுவனங்களின் கட்டணச் செயல்பாட்டுத் திறனை மேம்படுத்தவும் ஒழுங்குமுறை இணக்கத்தைப் பேணவும் உதவுகிறது.

title: Scattered Spider Hacker Sentenced to 6 Years Over $11.6M in Stolen Crypto
summary:
The sentencing highlights the growing legal consequences for cybercriminals and underscores the vulnerabilities in personal digital security.
The post Scattered Spider-linked hacker Tyler Buchanan gets 6 years over crypto SIM-swap thefts appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A hacker linked to the Scattered Spider cybercrime group has been sentenced to six years in prison following a large-scale cryptocurrency theft involving millions of dollars. The case underscores the growing legal crackdown on digital asset theft and highlights ongoing vulnerabilities in personal cybersecurity.
content_ta: Scattered Spider சைபர் கிரைம் கும்பலுடன் தொடர்புடைய ஒரு ஹேக்கருக்கு, மில்லியன் கணக்கில் கிரிப்டோகரன்சி திருடப்பட்ட வழக்கில் ஆறு ஆண்டுகள் சிறை தண்டனை விதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த வழக்கு டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து திருட்டுகள் மீதான சட்ட நடவடிக்கைகளையும், தனிப்பட்ட சைபர் பாதுகாப்பில் உள்ள குறைபாடுகளையும் சுட்டிக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: DBS lets eligible institutions in Asia mint and redeem USDC around the clock
summary: DBS and Circle are expanding institutional access to USDC with direct minting, redemption and 24/7 dollar settlement.
content: DBS and Circle have expanded institutional access to USDC, allowing eligible institutions in Asia to mint and redeem the stablecoin around the clock. This partnership provides these financial institutions with direct minting and redemption capabilities, as well as continuous dollar settlement services to enhance operational efficiency in the region.
content_ta: DBS மற்றும் Circle நிறுவனங்கள் இணைந்து USDC-க்கான நிறுவன முதலீட்டாளர்களின் அணுகலை விரிவுபடுத்தியுள்ளன. இதன் மூலம் ஆசியாவில் உள்ள தகுதியான நிறுவனங்கள் எந்த நேரத்திலும் USDC-ஐப் பெறவும் (mint) மாற்றவும் (redeem) முடியும். இந்த ஒத்துழைப்பு இப்பகுதியில் உள்ள நிதி நிறுவனங்களுக்கு நேரடி பரிமாற்ற வசதிகளையும், தடையற்ற டாலர் தீர்வு சேவைகளையும் வழங்குகிறது.

title: Bitcoin’s failed Nvidia earnings rally puts $62,000 support back in the spotlight
summary:
Nvidia’s first report since Jensen Huang’s departure topped sales estimates, while Bitcoin gave back most of its initial gain within 35 minutes.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: Nvidia reported strong sales for its first report since Jensen Huang's departure. Meanwhile, Bitcoin attempted a rally following the earnings report but quickly surrendered most of its initial gains within minutes. This failed momentum has brought the crucial $62,000 support level back into focus for market watchers.
content_ta: Jensen Huang-ன் வெளியேற்றத்திற்குப் பிறகு வெளியிடப்பட்ட முதல் அறிக்கையில் Nvidia நிறுவனம் சிறப்பான விற்பனை வளர்ச்சியைப் பதிவு செய்துள்ளது. இதற்கிடையில், இந்த நிறுவனத்தின் வருவாய் அறிக்கை வெளியானதும் Bitcoin விலையை உயர்த்திய முயற்சி தோல்வியடைந்ததுடன், குறுகிய நேரத்தில் தனது ஆரம்பகட்ட லாபத்தையும் இழந்தது. இந்த விலை சரிவு காரணமாக முக்கியமான $62,000 ஆதரவு நிலை மீண்டும் சந்தை ஆய்வாளர்களின் கவனத்திற்கு வந்துள்ளது.

title: Cardano faces $5 million adoption test after Hoskinson declares original roadmap complete
summary:
Cardano Foundation CEO Frederik Gregaard defended the blockchain's future as his organization sought nearly 25 million ADA to promote adoption. In a Nov. 15 statement, Gregaard argued that Cardano had become technologically stronger and more decentralized, pushing back against growing concerns about the network's future following controversial remarks by founder Charles Hoskinson. The comments followed…
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: Cardano faces a significant adoption test as the Cardano Foundation seeks nearly 25 million ADA to drive network growth. CEO Frederik Gregaard defended the blockchain's future following remarks by founder Charles Hoskinson, emphasizing that Cardano has grown technologically stronger and more decentralized as its original roadmap reaches completion.
content_ta: நெட்வொர்க் வளர்ச்சியை ஊக்குவிக்க Cardano Foundation கிட்டத்தட்ட 25 மில்லியன் ADA கோரியுள்ளதால், Cardano ஒரு முக்கியமான தத்தெடுப்புச் சோதனையை எதிர்கொள்கிறது. நிறுவனர் Charles Hoskinson இன் கருத்துகளைத் தொடர்ந்து, பிளாக்செயினின் எதிர்காலத்தை CEO Frederik Gregaard பாதுகாத்தார், மேலும் Cardano தொழில்நுட்ப ரீதியாக வலுவாகவும் அதிக பரவலாக்கப்பட்டதாகவும் வளர்ந்துள்ளது என்று வலியுறுத்தினார்.

title: Vitalik Buterin Wants Crypto to Have Housing’s Stability, But Can Ethereum Deliver?
summary:
Vitalik Buterin wants digital assets to offer housing-like stability, but can Ethereum roadmap help ETH become a long-term investment?
The post Vitalik Buterin Wants Crypto to Have Housing’s Stability, But Can Ethereum Deliver? appeared first on Cryptonews.
content: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has expressed a desire for digital assets to achieve a level of stability similar to the housing market. As the crypto community discusses the Ethereum roadmap and its potential to foster long-term investments, questions remain about whether the network can successfully deliver this kind of economic security.
content_ta: Ethereum co-founder ஆன Vitalik Buterin, டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்கள் வீட்டுவசதி சந்தையைப் போன்ற ஒரு நிலைத்தன்மையை அடைய வேண்டும் என்ற தனது விருப்பத்தை வெளிப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. Ethereum roadmap மற்றும் நீண்ட கால முதலீடுகளை ஊக்குவிக்கும் அதன் திறன் குறித்து கிரிப்டோ சமூகம் விவாதித்து வரும் நிலையில், இந்த பொருளாதார பாதுகாப்பை நெட்வொர்க்கால் வெற்றிகரமாக வழங்க முடியுமா என்ற கேள்வி எழுந்துள்ளது.

title: MEXC Announces Global Card Service Discontinuation
summary:
The shutdown highlights the vulnerability of crypto card services to third-party issuer changes, impacting user trust and service continuity.
The post MEXC shuts down Global Card service after third-party issuer changes appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Cryptocurrency exchange MEXC has announced the discontinuation of its Global Card service following changes made by its third-party issuer. This shutdown emphasizes the ongoing vulnerability and reliance that crypto card services have on external financial partners, which can impact user trust and disrupt service continuity across the platform.
content_ta: கிரப்டோகரன்சி எக்ஸ்சேஞ்ச் ஆன MEXC, தனது தேர்ட்-பார்ட்டி இஷ்யூவர் செய்த மாற்றங்களை அடுத்து, தனது Global Card சேவையை நிறுத்துவதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த மூடல், கிரிப்டோ கார்டு சேவைகள் வெளிப்புற நிதி பங்காளிகளைச் சார்ந்து இருப்பதன் மூலம் எதிர்கொள்ளும் பாதிப்புகளை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது, இது பயனர் நம்பிக்கையையும் சேவையின் தொடர்ச்சியையும் பாதிக்கிறது.

title: Investor Stanley Druckenmiller Is in “Capital Preservation” Mode. What Did He Sell?
summary:
Druckenmiller's 13F shows a 94% TSMC cut and a bigger Seagate stake, yet he says he is not long equities.
The post Investor Stanley Druckenmiller Is in “Capital Preservation” Mode. What Did He Sell? appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Investor Stanley Druckenmiller is currently in capital preservation mode, according to recent regulatory filings. His latest 13F filing reveals a significant 94% reduction in his TSMC holdings while increasing his stake in Seagate. Despite these adjustments, Druckenmiller noted that he is not currently long on equities.
content_ta: முதலீட்டாளர் Stanley Druckenmiller தற்போது மூலதனப் பாதுகாப்பு முறையில் உள்ளதாக சமீபத்திய ஆவணங்கள் காட்டுகின்றன. அவரது 13F தாக்கலின்படி, TSMC பங்குகளின் அளவை 94% வரை அவர் கணிசமாகக் குறைத்துள்ளார், அதே நேரத்தில் Seagate நிறுவனத்திலான தனது பங்குகளை அதிகரித்துள்ளார். இருப்பினும், தான் தற்போது பங்குகளில் நீண்ட கால முதலீடு செய்யவில்லை என்று அவர் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளார்.

title: Morpho launches on OKX’s X Layer with Gauntlet USDC vaults and tokenized stock loans
summary:
The integration of tokenized stock loans on OKX's X Layer could enhance liquidity and trading options but introduces complex risk dynamics.
The post Morpho launches on OKX’s X Layer with Gauntlet USDC vaults and tokenized stock loans appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Morpho has officially launched on OKX's X Layer, introducing Gauntlet USDC vaults and innovative tokenized stock loans. This integration aims to enhance liquidity and expand trading options on the network, although industry observers note that it also introduces more complex risk dynamics to the platform.
content_ta: OKX இன் X Layer-ல் Morpho தொடங்கப்பட்டுள்ளது, இது Gauntlet USDC vaults மற்றும் tokenized stock loans-ஐ அறிமுகப்படுத்துகிறது. இந்த ஒருங்கிணைப்பு நெட்வொர்க்கில் நீர்மைத்தன்மையை மேம்படுத்தவும் வர்த்தக விருப்பங்களை விரிவுபடுத்தவும் நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: Etherscan warns users after attempted unauthorized access to its support system
summary:
The incident highlights the critical need for vigilance against phishing scams, emphasizing user education on verifying support communications.
The post Etherscan warns users after attempted unauthorized access to its support system appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Blockchain analytics platform Etherscan issued a warning to users following an attempted unauthorized access incident targeting its support system. The platform emphasized the importance of staying vigilant against potential phishing scams and advised users to carefully verify all support communications to ensure security.
content_ta: Etherscan-ன் சப்போர்ட் சிஸ்டத்தை குறிவைத்து மேற்கொள்ளப்பட்ட ஒரு அங்கீகரிக்கdigiப்படாத அணுகல் முயற்சிக்குப் பிறகு, பயனர்களை எச்சரித்துள்ளது. பிஷிங் மோசடிகளுக்கு எதிராக எச்சரிக்கையாக இருப்பதன் அவசியத்தையும், சப்போர்ட் தகவல்தொடர்புகளை சரிபார்ப்பதையும் இந்தச் சம்பவம் வலியுறுத்துகிறது.

title: LMAX Group brings crypto perpetual futures to Fintake’s Helio platform
summary:
The integration of crypto perpetual futures into Helio could significantly increase market participation and risk exposure due to high leverage.
The post LMAX Group brings crypto perpetual futures to Fintake’s Helio platform appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: LMAX Group has integrated crypto perpetual futures into the Helio platform, operated by Fintake. This development expands the range of crypto-related financial products available to users. However, market experts note that the inclusion of perpetual futures, which often involve high leverage, could also lead to increased market participation and higher risk exposure for traders engaging with the platform.
content_ta: LMAX Group நிறுவனம் crypto perpetual futures-ஐ Fintake-ன் Helio platform-ல் இணைத்துள்ளது. இந்த புதிய ஒருங்கிணைப்பு பயனர்களுக்கு கிடைக்கும் crypto நிதி தயாரிப்புகளின் அளவை விரிவுபடுத்துகிறது. இருப்பினும், அதிக leverage கொண்ட இந்த perpetual futures வர்த்தகம் சந்தையில் பங்கேற்பதை அதிகரிப்பதுடன், வர்த்தகர்களுக்கு அதிகப்படியான அபாயத்தையும் ஏற்படுத்தக்கூடும் என்று சந்தை நிபுணர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: House Democrats investigate Commerce Secretary Lutnick over Megaspeed blacklisting delay
summary:
The investigation into Lutnick may lead to political fallout, affecting his tenure and impacting market perceptions of his future role.
The post House Democrats investigate Commerce Secretary Lutnick over Megaspeed blacklisting delay appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: House Democrats have launched an investigation into Commerce Secretary Lutnick regarding a delay in blacklisting Megaspeed. title: Riff Teams Up With Griffin to Power Automated Savings Across FSCS-Protected Banks
summary:
Riff, a savings agent that moves customers’ idle cash across a panel of FSCS-protected banks to access competitive interest rates, is partnering with Griffin to build its product on regulated banking infrastructure. 
Traditionally, customers looking to make their “lazy cash” work harder have to compare rates across banks, open accounts, transfer money manually and keep monitoring rate changes. Riff aims to take that effort away by automating the process of moving customers’ cash to banks where it can earn more, and bringing it back whenever they want it.
In this partnership, Griffin will provide the embedded bank accounts behind Riff’s offering: a hub account for each customer and a pooled savings account, serving as one of the panel banks on Riff.
Alongside giving customers access to competitive interest rates, Riff can also help them make the most of FSCS protection. The Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) protects eligible deposits up to £120,000 per person, per bank, so spreading money across more than one bank can protect a larger total balance. Together, this makes Riff a new, hands-off way to manage cash where customers set their preferences once, and Riff does the comparing, moving and checking from there.
Beyond individual customers, Riff works with platforms, advisers and employers that want to offer their clients a better home for idle cash. Riff is building its product and progressing through the regulatory process. The launch with Griffin is phased and subject to regulatory approval.
Speaking on the partnership with Griffin, Oliver Butcher, CEO and co-founder at Riff  says “Savers shouldn't have to become rate-watchers to get a fair return on their cash. Riff takes that job away entirely, and building on Griffin means we can do it on infrastructure that's built for regulated money from the ground up."
He further adds “Griffin has been great. From the moment we were introduced - helpful, knowledgeable and responsive. The type of culture and output I hope my own business can mirror.”
Phoebe Wallis, Chief Revenue Officer at Griffin added, “Riff is bringing a new approach to managing idle cash, the kind of ambitious product we love backing. We’re pleased to provide the regulated banking infrastructure underneath it as the team builds.”

content: Savings agent Riff has partnered with Griffin to build its automated savings product on regulated banking infrastructure. Riff moves customers' idle cash across FSCS-protected banks to secure competitive interest rates and maximize deposit protection without manual effort. Griffin will provide the embedded bank accounts behind the offering. The launch is phased and subject to regulatory approval.

FSCS-பாதுகாக்கப்பட்ட வங்கிகள் மூலம் வாடிக்கையாளர்களின் ஐடில் கேஷ் தொகையை தானாகவே நகர்த்தி, சிறந்த வட்டி விகிதங்களை பெற இந்த சேவை உதவுகிறது. இதன் மூலம் வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் வங்கிகளை மாற்றும் சிரமமின்றி பலன்களை பெறலாம். ஒழுங்குமுறை ஒப்புதலுக்கு உட்பட்டு இந்த சேவை படிப்படியாக அறிமுகப்படுத்தப்படுகிறது.

title: UK Wealth Managers Face Heavier Workloads Than Global Peers, Avaloq Research Reveals
summary:
UK wealth managers are managing significantly larger client books while spending more time on admin than their global peers, according to new research from Avaloq, a global leader in wealth management technology and services.
The findings reveal the scale of the pressures facing UK wealth managers – and the potential opportunities that could be unlocked – as firms pursue growth and consolidation while responding to increasingly complex client needs.
Avaloq's wealth insights 2026 research, conducted among 480 wealth management professionals and 4,256 investors globally, finds that UK wealth managers serve an average of 82 clients, compared with 57 globally. This represents a client book approximately 44% larger than the global average.
At the same time, UK wealth managers spend a third (32%) of their working time on admin, compared with 21% globally. Almost two thirds (63%) identify administrative workloads as a barrier to spending more time with clients, while 40% point to insufficient automation.
The findings come as UK wealth management firms seek to expand, both organically and through acquisitions. While consolidation offers opportunities to increase scale and reach new clients, it can also create additional operational demands as firms integrate different systems, processes and data.
Technology is not yet relieving the pressure
Despite technology being the obvious solution, many UK wealth managers believe their firm's systems fall short. Only 28% say they are satisfied with their firm's technology, while 58% believe their organisation is moving too slowly on digital transformation, compared with 50% globally.
The research also reveals significant obstacles to delivering personalised client service. Almost two thirds (63%) of UK wealth managers cite poor internal collaboration as a barrier, while 55% point to limited client data analytics and 53% report difficulties accessing client data.
Suman Rao, Managing Director for the UK and Ireland at Avaloq, says: "UK wealth managers have bright futures ahead, but our research shows that they are also under considerable pressure and not always able to fulfil their full potential. They are managing substantially larger client books than their global peers, but spending a substantial part of their working time on admin. As firms grow they need to make complexity doesn’t grow too, because more often than not this means more administrative work, which can result in less time for clients.
“Technology has a critical role to play in addressing this challenge, but our findings suggest that many firms are not yet getting the support they need from their existing systems. Wealth managers should be able to access client information easily, work effectively across their organisations and spend more of their time providing advice. Instead, too many are dealing with fragmented data, manual processes and systems that add to their workload.
"The industry is consolidating rapidly, which can compound these challenges, because acquiring scale and benefiting from scale are two different things. As firms grow, they need to ensure their technology can support larger client books without placing unnecessary additional demands on their people. The decisions firms make about their technology today will shape how effectively they can grow over the next five to ten years and beyond, so it’s vital wealth managers are supported by systems that enable them to deliver the personalised service clients expect."

The study highlights that British professionals handle an average of 82 clients and spend 32% of their time on admin. Many firms struggle with slow digital transformation, fragmented data, and outdated technology, hindering their ability to deliver personalised client service amid industry growth and consolidation.

title: Lianlian DigiTech and Visa Advance Trusted B2B Agentic Commerce for Small and Medium-Sized Businesses
summary:
Lianlian DigiTech and Visa, a global leader in digital payments, today announced the next phase of their collaboration to advance trusted B2B agentic commerce. The companies have completed their first live transaction in Asia Pacific through Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect, using a tokenised payment credential designed specifically for an authorised AI agent. Also unveiled at the Singapore Fintech Festival, Lianlian DigiTech is also launching LianLian XCard, powered by Visa Intelligent Commerce, extending the collaboration into business spending and expense management. 
The latest transaction builds on an earlier live purchasing journey and shows how an authorised AI agent can complete a business purchase using a credential designed for agentic commerce. For small and medium-sized businesses, these capabilities offer opportunities to simplify routine purchasing and payments while retaining control over spending. Together with LianLian XCard, the developments can help businesses spend less time managing everyday transactions and more time focused on customers and growth.
From controlled purchases to agent-initiated payments
In the earlier transaction, Lianlian DigiTech’s AI agent, LoopX Pay, identified a purchasing requirement, evaluated suppliers, placed an order and completed payment within predefined spending limits and approval requirements. In the latest transaction, LianLian XWorker, an AI agent registered in the Visa Agentic Directory obtained an agent-specific tokenised payment credential through Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect and completed a live office supply purchase.
The new credential adds an agent-specific payment capability to the end-to-end experience. Together with agent identification and business-defined controls, it supports transactions in which businesses can determine what an authorised agent may purchase and how payment is made.
Bringing greater control to everyday business spend
From 18 November 2026, eligible clients can apply for LianLian XCard through LianLian XWorker. Designed to help businesses manage spending across teams and projects, LianLian XCard offers tools including card limits and transaction thresholds. Customers can also link their LianLian XPay wallet to enable authorised AI agents to make payments using LianLian XCard within business-defined parameters. Selected AI-related benefits are planned for eligible customers.
“As AI agents take on a greater role in commerce, trust will be essential to helping businesses adopt these new capabilities with confidence,” said Stephen Karpin, President, Asia Pacific, Visa. “Our collaboration with Lianlian DigiTech brings together Visa's B2B payment capabilities and Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect to support secure, controlled agent-initiated payments. This creates new opportunities for small and medium-sized businesses across Asia Pacific to simplify purchasing, expand their reach and focus on growth.”
“AI is creating new opportunities for businesses around the world. As agents take on more of the work behind commerce, from evaluating options and coordinating purchases to making payments, security, trust and control must remain fundamental,” said Tim Shen, Co-President of Lianlian DigiTech. “With LianLian XCard, we are also bringing AI-powered financial capabilities and global business payments closer to companies’ everyday needs. We look forward to building on this partnership and helping more businesses embrace intelligent commerce with confidence.”
Together, the next phase of the collaboration and the launch of LianLian XCard will give businesses more ways to manage purchasing and payments as AI becomes part of everyday commercial activity. Lianlian DigiTech and Visa will continue exploring applications across procurement, supplier payments and other B2B workflows, helping businesses pursue new opportunities as intelligent commerce develops.

Additionally, Lianlian DigiTech is launching LianLian XCard, powered by Visa, to help businesses manage spending and expense management through integrated AI tools and wallets.

title: Apicunia and PayPoint Partner to Extend European Payee Verification
summary:
Apicunia has partnered with PayPoint to bring its European Verification of Payee (VoP) service to PayPoint customers, helping businesses verify beneficiary details before payments are made.
 
The partnership builds on PayPoint’s existing capabilities, including multichannel payments, Open Banking, Confirmation of Payee (CoP), and API-led platforms by adding European VoP through Apicunia’s specialist technology. The service allows customers to verify beneficiary names against account details before initiating a payment. Checking payment details earlier in the process can help businesses reduce payment errors, strengthen fraud controls and avoid the disruption of discovering a problem when a payment is ready to go.
 
While CoP supports name-checking for UK payments, VoP extends this capability to payments covered by the European scheme, enabling customers to check beneficiary details across additional markets.
 

Gary Farrow, Founder and CEO of Apicunia, said:
“We’re delighted to be partnering with PayPoint. Bringing together their payment expertise and market reach with Apicunia’s payee verification capabilities creates exciting opportunities. We look forward to collaborating to bring new services to market centred on ‘Know Your Payee’, helping businesses understand who they are paying and transacting with greater confidence.” 
Simon Coles, Managing Director at PayPoint, added: 
“Our customers need simple, reliable ways to check that payments are going to the intended recipient. Combining PayPoint’s payments expertise with Apicunia’s specialist Verification of Payee technology will help customers identify potential discrepancies earlier and make payments with greater confidence.” 
The partnership marks an important milestone in Apicunia’s work to make payee verification accessible to more businesses.

The collaboration aims to help businesses verify beneficiary details before initiating payments, reducing errors, strengthening fraud controls, and extending verification capabilities beyond the UK market into European schemes.

content_ta: UAE-ஐச் சேர்ந்த Ziina என்ற ஃபின்டெக் நிறுவனம், Split Bill என்ற புதிய அம்சத்தை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. பயனர்கள் தங்களின் குழு செலவுகளை எளிதாகப் பிரிக்கவும், கட்டண நினைவூட்டல்களைத் தானியங்குபடுத்தவும், கணக்குகளைத் துல்லியமாக நிர்வகிக்கவும் இந்த வசதி உதவுகிறது. title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 6: FE Covenants — Enforcing covenants through cryptographically restricted signing keys
summary: FE covenants encode spending constraints into the signing key, so only transactions that satisfy a predefined condition can be signed.
content: Bitcoin Covenants Part 6 explores FE covenants, a method for enforcing spending constraints through cryptographically restricted signing keys. By encoding spending conditions directly into the signing key, FE covenants ensure that only transactions satisfying predefined rules can be properly signed, advancing the capabilities of programmable transactions on the Bitcoin network.
content_ta: Bitcoin Covenants-ன் ஆறாம் பாகம், cryptographically restricted signing keys மூலம் செலவழிப்பு கட்டுப்பாடுகளை அமல்படுத்தும் FE covenants பற்றிக் விளக்குகிறது. செலவழிப்பு நிபந்தனைகளை நேரடியாக signing key-ல் குறியீடு செய்வதன் மூலம், முன்கூட்டியே வரையறுக்கப்பட்ட விதிகளைப் பூர்த்தி செய்யும் பரிவர்த்தனைகளை மட்டுமே கையெழுத்திட முடியும் என்பதை FE covenants உறுதி செய்கிறது.

content_ta: Binance-ல் ஹேக்கிங் செய்த நபர், சுமார் $136.8 மில்லியன் மதிப்புள்ள 74,880 ETH-ஐ THORchain மூலம் நகர்த்தியுள்ளார். பிளாக்செயின் கண்காணிப்பு தரவுகளின்படி, அந்த ஹேக்கர் இந்த தொகையை Bitcoin-ஆக மாற்றியுள்ளார். Ethereum-ன் இந்த பெருமளவிலான விற்பனை, டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து சந்தையில் உள்ள பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் குறுக்கு-சங்கிலி (cross-chain) கண்காணிப்பு சவால்களை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது.

title: Visa expands Agentic Ready programme to acceptance ecosystem
summary: Visa has expanded its Agentic Ready programme to the merchant acceptance ecosystem, signing up big names including Fiserv, PayPal and Stripe.
content: Visa has announced the expansion of its Agentic Ready programme into the merchant acceptance ecosystem. Major industry players such as Fiserv, PayPal, and Stripe have joined the initiative. This move aims to enhance and adapt payment acceptance infrastructure for new digital commerce trends and emerging technologies, fostering broader collaboration across the global financial and merchant networks.
content_ta: Visa தனது Agentic Ready திட்டத்தை merchant acceptance ecosystem-ல் விரிவுபடுத்துவதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. Fiserv, PayPal மற்றும் Stripe உள்ளிட்ட முன்னணி நிறுவனங்கள் இதில் இணைந்துள்ளன. புதிய டிஜிட்டல் வர்த்தக போக்குகள் மற்றும் வளர்ந்து வரும் தொழில்நுட்பங்களுக்கு ஏற்ப கட்டண ஏற்பாட்டு உள்கட்டமைப்பை மேம்படுத்துவதை இந்த நடவடிக்கை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: Nomupay joins Amazon Web Services marketplace
summary: Nomupay, the global fintech that offers a unified end-to-end payments platform through a single integration, announced today that it has joined the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Independent Software Vendor (ISV) Accelerate Program, a co-sell program for AWS Partners that provides software solutions that run on or integrate with AWS.

title: Miden and Visa partner on commercial card issuing for African businesses

content: Enterprise payment infrastructure provider Miden has partnered with Visa to enhance commercial card issuing for African businesses. This collaboration is designed to expand digital commercial payment capabilities, specifically targeting mid-to-large-sized enterprises across the African continent to streamline their financial operations and foster digital growth.
content_ta: எண்டர்பிரைஸ் பேமெண்ட் இன்ஃப்ராஸ்ட்ரக்சர் வழங்குநரான Miden, ஆப்பிரிக்க வணிகங்களுக்கான கமர்ஷியல் கார்டு வழங்கும் சேவையை மேம்படுத்த Visa உடன் கூட்டு சேர்ந்துள்ளது. இந்த ஒத்துழைப்பு ஆப்பிரிக்க கண்டத்தில் உள்ள நடுத்தர மற்றும் பெரிய நிறுவனங்களை குறிவைத்து டிஜிட்டல் வணிகப் பரிவர்த்தனை திறன்களை விரிவுபடுத்தும் நோக்கம் கொண்டது.

title: Beyond fraud detection: Why dispute management needs an overhaul
summary: Post-incident fraud management needs to adapt. But how?
content: Traditional post-incident fraud detection and dispute management systems require a significant overhaul to keep pace with modern challenges. As fraudulent activities evolve, businesses must adapt their strategies beyond basic detection to effectively handle customer disputes and streamline the resolution process.
content_ta: பாரம்பரிய பிந்தைய மோசடி கண்டறிதல் மற்றும் தகராறு மேலாண்மை அமைப்புகளில் நவீன சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்ள பெரிய அளவில் மாற்றங்கள் செய்யப்பட வேண்டும். மோசடி நடவடிக்கைகள் நாளுக்கு நாள் மாறுவதால், வணிக நிறுவனங்கள் அடிப்படை கண்டறிதலை தாண்டி வாடிக்கையாளர் தகராடுகளை திறம்பட கையாள்வதற்கும் தீர்வுகளை விரைவுபடுத்துவதற்கும் தங்கள் உத்திகளை மாற்றியமைக்க வேண்டும்.

title: The Intersection of Autonomous AI Agents, Enterprise Liability, and Insurance Underwriting
summary: Author: A finextra community member
content: The rise of autonomous AI agents in the enterprise sector introduces complex questions surrounding liability and risk management. As these intelligent systems make independent operational decisions, insurers face new challenges in underwriting and determining accountability when errors occur. Industry experts are actively examining how corporate insurance frameworks must adapt to address the unique legal and financial exposures associated with fully automated business processes.
content_ta: எண்டர்பிரைஸ் துறையில் தன்னாட்சி AI ஏஜெண்டுகளின் எழுச்சி, பொறுப்பு மற்றும் ஆபத்து மேலாண்மை தொடர்பான சிக்கலான கேள்விகளை எழுப்புகிறது. இந்த அமைப்புகள் சுதந்திரமான முடிவுகளை எடுப்பதால், பிழைகள் ஏற்படும் போது காப்பீட்டு நிறுவனங்கள் புதிய சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்கின்றன.

title: A $1.5 billion crypto startup is taking on Hyperliquid with a Wall Street playbook
summary: Variational and its investors are betting that the future of onchain trading will look more like a traditional brokerage than a crypto exchange.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
summary: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions to ask about where assets are held.
content: Recent security breaches have highlighted the risks of cryptocurrency exchanges acting as both trading venues and asset custodians. Industry experts argue that digital asset institutions should separate trading and custody functions, following the long-standing model of traditional financial markets. Ensuring that client funds are kept secure in dedicated vaults away from trading platforms is crucial for protecting investor assets against major security threats.
content_ta: கிரிப்டோகரன்சி எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சுகள் வர்த்தக தளங்களாகவும் கஸ்டடியன்களாகவும் ஒரே நேரத்தில் செயல்படுவதன் ஆபத்துகளை சமீபத்திய பாதுகாப்பு மீறல்கள் வெளிப்படுத்தியுள்ளன. பாரம்பரிய நிதிச் சந்தைகளைப் போலவே, டிஜிட்டல் அசெட் நிறுவனங்களும் வர்த்தகத்தையும் கஸ்டடியையும் தனித்தனியாக வைத்திருக்க வேண்டும் என்று வல்லுநர்கள் வாதிடுகின்றனர். வாடிக்கையாளர்களின் நிதியை வர்த்தக தளங்களிலிருந்து விலக்கி பாதுகாப்பான வாலட்களில் வைத்திருப்பது முதலீட்டாளர்களின் சொத்துக்களைப் பாதுகாக்க மிகவும் அவசியமாகும்.

title: $25M Ethereum MEV acquittal tests criminal enforcement limits
summary: BlackRock’s staked Ether ETF earns a cut of what traders pay for priority on Ethereum, the acquittal left the legal risk to that income unresolved.
content: A notable cryptocurrency acquittal involving millions in Ethereum MEV has highlighted the current limits of criminal enforcement in the digital asset sector. The case leaves unresolved legal questions regarding the income generated from transaction priority fees, such as those associated with BlackRock's staked Ether ETF, raising ongoing compliance and regulatory debates for traders and financial institutions alike.
content_ta: மில்லியன் கணக்கான மதிப்பில் நடந்த Ethereum MEV தொடர்பான ஒரு குறிப்பிடத்தக்க விடுதலை வழக்கு, டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து துறையில் கிரிமினல் அமலாக்கத்தின் தற்போதைய எல்லைகளை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டியுள்ளது. BlackRock இன் staked Ether ETF போன்ற பரிவர்த்தனை முன்னுரிமை கட்டணங்கள் மூலம் ஈட்டப்படும் வருமானம் குறித்த சட்டப்பூர்வ கேள்விகளை இந்தத் தீர்ப்பு தீர்க்கப்படாமல் விட்டுள்ளது, இது வர்த்தகர்கள் மற்றும் நிதி நிறுவனங்களுக்கு தொடர்ந்து ஒழுங்குமுறை விவாதங்களை எழுப்புகிறது.

title: Polymarket US takes rapid-fire crypto trading format to oil, natural gas
summary:
Polymarket's expansion into rapid energy trading highlights the growing reliance on oracle networks, potentially reshaping commodity markets.
The post Polymarket US brings 15-minute trading to oil and natural gas appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Polymarket US has expanded its rapid-fire trading format to include commodities like oil and natural gas, offering 15-minute trading intervals. This move highlights the growing reliance on oracle networks within the sector. The development could potentially reshape traditional commodity markets by introducing fast-paced prediction and trading mechanisms to the energy industry.

title: Lucky Trader Banks 66,000% Profit on GTA 6 Meme Coin Ticker Confusion

title: 'It Speaks in Tongues That Only 6.2 Astra Understands': Why Early Testers Hate OpenAI’s New Model

title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin is back in a bearish phase but has reached a ‘value zone’

title: Bullish’s Q3 adjusted profit rises 35%, digital asset sales fall 23%

title: Visa Direct to extend stablecoin prefunding for cross-border payouts to Asia-Pacific

content_ta: Visa நிறுவனம் தனது Visa Direct தளத்தை விஸ்தரித்து, Asia-Pacific பிராந்தியத்தில் உள்ள தகுதியான வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் stablecoins மூலம் எல்லை தாண்டிய கட்டணங்களைச் செலுத்த அனுமதிக்கிறது. பாரம்பரிய கட்டண வலையமைப்பில் பிளாக்செயின் அடிப்படையிலான டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களை இணைப்பதன் மூலம் சர்வதேச பரிவர்த்தனைகளை எளிதாக்குவதும், வணிகங்களின் செயல்திறனை மேம்படுத்துவதும் இந்த திட்டத்தின் நோக்கமாகும்.

title: StoneX cuts Bitdeer price target to $15 amid new US chip export controls
summary: StoneX trimmed its 2027 revenue and EBITDA estimates for Bitdeer to account for Malaysian licensing scenarios, among other factors.

title: WSDT introduces prop trading for crypto and tokenized US stocks
summary: One-step challenges start at $19, with a free demo and weekly competitions available in the same trading terminal DUBAI, UAE, November 18, 2026 – WSDT is introducing its prop trading platform for cryptocurrency perpetual futures, gold and tokenized US stocks. Traders can access these markets through a single simulated account, with one-step evaluations starting at a one-time fee of $19 for a $1,500 account. The platform combines crypto perpetual futures, including Bitcoin and Ethereum, with xStocks instruments tracking companies such as Apple, NVIDIA and Tesla, alongside stock-index ETFs. Perpetual futures are contracts without an expiry date; xStocks track the prices of underlying shares or ETFs. On WSDT, these instruments are traded in a simulated environment, without ownership of the underlying shares or tokens. Positions across the markets share the same account balance and count toward the same evaluation. Traders can work across crypto and equity-linked instruments in one terminal while managing a single set of account limits. One evaluation, published trading rules A WSDT challenge tests trading performance against a 10% profit target, a 4% daily loss limit and a 6% maximum drawdown fixed against the starting account size. Traders must trade on at least four separate days, with no deadline to complete the evaluation. Account sizes range from $1,500 to $200,000, with fees varying by size. Traders who pass move to a funded-stage account, which is also simulated and retains the loss limits. They receive 80% of eligible profits under WSDT’s Provider Service Agreement. The evaluation fee pays for access to the challenge; it is not a trading deposit. Free ways to try the platform Registered users can open a free 14-day demo with a $100,000 simulated balance, without providing a payment card or making a deposit. The demo uses the same terminal as challenges, allowing traders to practice before entering an evaluation. Demo results do not qualify for payouts. WSDT also runs an ongoing weekly competition with free entry. Every participant starts with a $240,000 simulated balance, and the top three finishers receive challenge accounts. A new round opens each Monday at noon New York time. Winners must pass their awarded challenge before progressing to the funded stage. Registration, account options and full challenge rules are available on the WSDT website. About WSDT WSDT provides trader evaluation and educational services across crypto, gold and tokenized equity instruments. Built by TEFS, a prop trading firm established in 2017, it is operated by TEFS Marketing Management L.L.C. in Dubai, UAE. All WSDT trading accounts are simulated. Contact WSDT support@wsdt.com
content: WSDT has launched a new prop trading platform in Dubai, offering simulated trading for cryptocurrency perpetual futures, gold, and tokenized US stocks. Built by TEFS, the platform allows traders to access multiple markets through a single account. Features include one-step evaluations starting at $19, a free 14-day demo, and weekly trading competitions. Traders who pass evaluations can access funded-stage accounts and receive a share of eligible profits.

title: OnCommerce Extends Adyen Partnership to Power Checkout Across easyShop and Comet
summary:
OnCommerce, the marketplace technology company that powers and operates OnBuy, easyShop and Comet, has expanded its partnership with Adyen, the global financial technology platform of choice for leading businesses.
Following the successful rollout of Adyen on OnBuy earlier this year, OnCommerce has now extended the platform across easyShop and Comet. The move brings payments across 43 sites, 21 markets and eight currencies into one system, giving the business a single view of transactions, reporting and reconciliation across all three brands.
The partnership helps simplify operations as OnCommerce continues to scale internationally, while also supporting a smoother checkout experience for customers. With Adyen Protect, transactions are assessed in real time using machine learning and signals from Adyen’s global payments network, helping identify legitimate shoppers more accurately, reduce fraud and minimise unnecessary friction during checkout.
Adyen also gives OnCommerce greater flexibility as it expands. The platform supports a wide range of local payment methods through a single integration, allowing the business to introduce new ways for customers to pay quickly as it enters new markets.
“Over the past year, we've grown from a single marketplace into a multi-brand retail business serving customers across multiple markets and currencies. As we've expanded, it became increasingly important to bring payments across OnBuy, easyShop and Comet together under one roof," said Cas Paton, Founder & CEO of OnCommerce. "Extending our partnership with Adyen gives us a clearer view of the business, faster reconciliation and the ability to deliver a consistent checkout experience across all three brands. Just as importantly, it gives us the flexibility to keep evolving our payment offering and the foundation to support our next stage of growth."
“Expanding into new markets is a huge opportunity for retailers, but it also brings greater complexity, particularly when it comes to payments. Businesses need technology that can support their growth without making the shopping experience more complicated for customers," said Nicole Olbe, President of EMEA at Adyen. "By bringing payments across OnBuy, easyShop and Comet onto one platform, we’re helping OnCommerce simplify its operations, better understand its customers and introduce the payment methods shoppers prefer in each market. It’s a great example of how the right payments infrastructure can help ambitious businesses scale while delivering a seamless experience for customers.”

title: Red Hat Brings Lightwell Network to Microsoft Marketplace
summary:
Red Hat, the world's leading provider of open source solutions, today announced expanded enterprise access to Lightwell Network through availability in the Microsoft Marketplace, the unified online destination for customers to buy trusted cloud solutions,  AI apps, and agents to meet their business needs. Red Hat customers can now discover and deploy Lightwell Network through Microsoft Marketplace, with streamlined management across Microsoft Azure and other Microsoft products.
By making Lightwell Network available via Microsoft Marketplace, Red Hat is making it easier for customers to access eligible, version-specific remediated open source packages through secured repositories, with signed artifacts and supporting provenance, Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) and vulnerability information as applicable.
Lightwell Network is designed to fit into existing software delivery workflows, allowing organisations to use their current vulnerability scanners, artifact repositories, build systems and deployment processes while consuming available Lightwell-remediated packages through secured repositories. These findings can surface in Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and Azure Policy brings governance to the same pipeline, so security and IT teams get visibility and control without changing how developers work.
The accessibility of Lightwell Network on Microsoft Marketplace builds upon Red Hat’s broader open hybrid cloud portfolio, spanning Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Red Hat OpenShift and Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform. While Lightwell is agnostic of the underlying software platforms, consuming patches at AI-scale velocity requires a modern application pipeline. title: Supermicro Ships First All-Flash Storage Servers, Delivering PCIe Gen 6 Performance and Broad Software-Defined Storage Support for AI Training and Inference
summary:

The first systems, now shipping, include the Petascale system powered by the 6th Gen AMD EPYC 9006 Series processors (formerly codenamed "Venice"), with more products to follow as AMD launches new SP8 CPU versions. These are the first storage products supporting the PCIe Gen 6 I/O specification with 100% greater sequential read bandwidth over PCIe Gen 5.
"Expanding AI and HPC workloads require storage that can match the performance of today's CPU and GPU clusters," said Vik Malyala, chief business officer at Supermicro. "With our new all-flash storage servers based on AMD EPYC processors, and the flexibility of the DCBBS architecture, we are delivering improved PCIe Gen 6 bandwidth, high density, and scalable capacity. These platforms can be customized for HPC, AI training, and inference workloads, while providing software-defined storage partners with proven, validated systems they can rely on."
Supermicro will be showing the new Petascale all-flash storage server in booth #4017 at Supercomputing 2026, in Chicago, November 15-20.
The first system in the new family packs exceptional density into a 2U chassis with support for up to 32 E3.S NVMe SSDs—delivering as much as 3.93 PB of capacity with 122 TB drives. Its balanced I/O architecture supports up to four x16 high-performance networking cards, enabling the sustained bandwidth required for AI data lakes, large-scale analytics, and high-throughput storage networking while giving customers the flexibility to optimize for their specific workload and fabric requirements.
